svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Every model, in all 10 languages
svg.desc: Each model's MTVA Score in each language.
svg.text: MTVA Score by the language of the call. Models ranked by overall score.

text.tspan: Each cell is the mean MTVA Score over that language's calls; the number of calls is under each name. The agent speaks the caller's

svg.text: language, and the judge holds it to the language and register its system prompt sets.
